key_decisions.rationale: Keeps hypothetical exposure and Paul's qualification.
key_decisions.before: lest if some Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—not to say you—would be put to shame in this confidence.
key_decisions.after: Otherwise, if Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—to say nothing of you—would be ashamed in this confidence.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: lest if some Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—not to say you—would be put to shame in this confidence.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves advance preparation and generosity/coercion contrast.
key_decisions.before: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers and sisters to go on ahead to you and arrange in advance the generous gift you had promised, so that it may be ready as a blessing and not as something forced.
key_decisions.after: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to go to you in advance and prepare beforehand the generous gift you had already promised, so that it would be ready as a gift and not as something extorted.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to go on ahead to you and arrange in advance the generous gift you had promised, so that it may be ready as a blessing and not as something forced.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps agrarian image and repeated measure.
key_decisions.before: The point is this: the one who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and the one who sows generously will also reap generously.
key_decisions.after: The point is this: the one who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and the one who sows with blessings will also reap with blessings.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The point is this: the one who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and the one who sows generously will also reap generously.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves inward decision, freedom, and quoted reason.
key_decisions.before: Each one must give as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
key_decisions.after: Each person should give as decided in the heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Each one must give as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

key_decisions.before: God can make all grace abound to you, so that having all sufficiency in everything at all times, you may abound in every good work.
key_decisions.after: And God is able to make every grace overflow to you, so that in everything, always having everything you need, you may overflow in every good work.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that having all sufficiency in everything at all times, you may abound in every good work.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps provider, agricultural chain, and moral harvest.
key_decisions.before: The one who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your seed for sowing and increase the harvest of your righteousness.
key_decisions.after: The one who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your seed and increase the harvest of your righteousness.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The one who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your seed for sowing and increase the harvest of your righteousness.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves tested service, confession, and broad sharing.
key_decisions.before: Through the proof of this ministry, they glorify God because of your obedience in the confession of the good news of Christ and the generosity of your sharing with them and with all.
key_decisions.after: Because this ministry has proved your character, they will glorify God for the obedience of your confession of Christ's gospel and for the generosity of your sharing with them and with everyone.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Through the proof of this ministry, they glorify God because of your obedience in the confession of the good news of Christ and the generosity of your sharing with them and with all.
